Introduction

Kwon Jung-yeol is a South Korean singer and songwriter signed to Magic Strawberry Sound. He is best known as a member of the duo 10cm, which debuted in 2010. Initially a two-member group, Kwon Jung-yeol continued as a one-man band after the departure of Yoon Cheol-jong in 2017, maintaining the stage name 10cm.

In June 2014, Kwon Jung-yeol married Kim Yoon Ju, a member of OKDAL, with the news confirmed by their agency. Kwon’s career gained significant momentum with the release of popular songs such as "Tell Me It's Not a Dream" and "Spring Snow." Both tracks became widely recognized after being featured as OSTs for the highly rated 2024 dramas "Queen of Tears" and "Lovely Runner," respectively, further establishing his impact in the music industry.
